purpose: Carry V11 command input to the existing Prometeo execution path without exposing repository credentials or raw private command text in public GitHub metadata.

private_payload.text: raw command text; MUST NOT be committed to the public Prometeo repository by the bridge

public_repo_may_receive: durable sanitized execution metadata produced by the existing authority path
public_repo_must_never_receive: raw command text unless separately and explicitly classified public by a later authority contract

zero_cost_candidate.reason: A public GitHub Pages script cannot safely embed a GitHub write credential; client-side credentials are readable by page code and users. GitHub Pages itself provides no authenticated write endpoint.
zero_cost_candidate.smallest_safe_shape: One trusted HTTPS transport already controlled by Prometeo or a zero-cost/free-tier bridge that holds GitHub App installation credentials server-side and only writes sanitized metadata into the existing Prometeo authority surface.
zero_cost_candidate.unresolved_external_boundary: A trusted authenticated HTTP transport must exist somewhere outside the public page runtime. Until one is bound, the browser adapter returns AUTH_BRIDGE_REQUIRED and V11 keeps the command text intact for fallback.
zero_cost_candidate.github_only_strict_mode: If strict GitHub-only means no trusted HTTP bridge at all, automatic browser-to-GitHub durable write remains an authentication boundary rather than something this adapter fakes.

evidence_law: queued=true is accepted only with schema prometeo.ingress-transport-result/v1
queued=true also requires a durable ref inside JuanManuelPM/prometeo
malformed success responses downgrade to BOUNDARY_TRANSPORT_INVALID
